findings.issue: voice_plan.require_source_diversity is false. All three voice samples are interview_guest. QA judges this an acceptable, honest exception: he has published no prose, the specials are private, pulled or untranscribed, and Kill Tony is mixed-voice by design. The samples are spread across two hosts (Theo Von, Rogan), two years (2022, 2026) and three modes (storytelling, declarative, defending). All three were confirmed verbatim against the diarized transcript and the raw captions, with correct speaker attribution.
findings.recommendation: Revisit if a transcript of Man of the People (Netflix, Jun 9 2026), Making Friends, or the Tom Brady or Kevin Hart roast sets is acquired; a solo performance sample would be the strongest addition.
